title: Missing moeb tool: Glob
description: Used Glob (Claude Code) to find patch_file*.rs source files and .signal.json files by glob pattern. No moeb equivalent exists for pattern-based file discovery. grep_files supports substring search but not glob patterns.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a glob_files moeb tool covering pattern-based file discovery (e.g. **/*.signal.json, **/patch_file*.rs), eliminating the need for external Glob calls.
